ratings_why.fun: Every slot is a wiring choice, and Tie plus Gossip lets me splice other tribes' engines into the knot; the Gossip quarter often rounds to little early, which keeps it under an 8.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because split damage rewrites every shared keyword (Shield, DR, Hunker, Bristle) and every 'takes damage' trigger, which no tribe today or generic auto-battler does.

verdict_why: The rules now read cleanly and the combo web is rich; more passes would change it, not improve it.

points.text: Cheese-Rind Keeper's +3/+3 alone gives each Gossip 0 after rounding a quarter; +4/+4 would make the Gossip Mill land on its own from the first turn it's built.
Knot of Ill Omen plus Mill-Chimney Sweep (hits each Tied enemy) is a lovely unlisted pairing; say it in a build so players find it.
Nothing rewards running two Knots on purpose; one mid-tier unit that counts your Knots would give the Piper's split-board plan an earlier step.
Little Fips wants an empty slot next to him while the knot wants no gaps; that tension is good, and could carry late if his bonus counted the Knot's units at End of Turn permanently once a game.

standouts.why: The Piper turns the tribe's own rule off for an opening volley, and reading order with the King and Sniffer makes it a real puzzle.
Supper Sniffer copying Shield or DR across a knot that splits damage per share is a combo engine and a trap at once.
Ilse turns tied Oozes, Hunters and Hedgerow Pass into shared growth: cross-tribe combo in one card.

weakest.why: Loyal Cagemate is a plain deathrattle body; its only knot job is patching Quorum.
Cold-Shed Tangle is a one-line seed with no decision beyond where the Stray goes.
Ticklish Chirper is a smaller Gundel; fine by rule 3 but adds no new interaction.

flags.note: With Old Gundel, every enemy hit gives all seven +1 Attack while the shared pool keeps them alive; ends with the fight but can snowball inside it.
Golden Sniffer gives DR to the whole knot, applied per share; small and mid hits may do almost nothing.
Golden Ilse makes every Gossip in her knot gain the knot's full gains; with two or three Gossip units and a tied Ooze, growth multiplies each turn.
